Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of the Act serves as the legal basis for the government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to issue or amend customs notifications in the public interest.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of the Act provides the authority to the government to implement changes in tax-related notifications.
S.R.O. 132-AIN/2017: This existing notification is amended to update the list of goods and conditions applicable to cellular phone manufacturing and assembly.
TABLE-I: The table is updated to replace existing entries for Heading 85.41 with new specific descriptions including diodes, transistors, LEDs, and thermistors.
TABLE-II: The table is amended to replace existing entries for HS Code 39.26 with mobile accessories and to insert new entries for Heading 73.19 and Heading 85.38 covering specific electronic parts.
Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory: The Commission is designated as the competent authority for oversight and certification, replacing references to the previous postal and telecommunication division in the notification conditions and appendices.
Industrial Importation: The scope of manufacturing and assembly under this notification is expanded to explicitly include cellular phone batteries, chargers, PCBA, and other related components or accessories.

Statutory Regulatory Order: This instrument specifies that its legal provisions shall come into effect on a designated date in mid-June of the year two thousand nineteen.
